page.overview:
Who is General Tarsal?

General Tarsal is an ant with a Kiwi accent and is the Queen of the Ant Nation. In "Dentist," she enlists Finn to fight monster worms in exchange for dental services, and she assigns Tiffany to be Finn's partner.

Tarsal is rounder than the other ants in the colony and appeared to be pregnant in her one appearance. She wears a green military cap and has two medals strapped to her chest. Tarsal also carries around a swagger stick.
